overviewParagraph: The Golden Designs Karlstad 6 Person Hybrid PureTech Full Spectrum Outdoor Sauna offers a luxurious and rejuvenating experience for outdoor relaxation. Designed to accommodate up to six people, this sauna combines a powerful 8.0 kW stove with advanced Full Spectrum IR technology, featuring 13 IR emitters and 4 Carbon PureTech™ Near Zero EMF heating panels. Crafted with an espresso all-weather exterior and a Canadian Red Cedar interior, it provides a serene environment enhanced by chromotherapy lighting and red light therapy for stress relief and improved circulation. With built-in Bluetooth connectivity and performance speakers, this sauna transforms your backyard into a personal wellness retreat.

Product Ad-Copy: With a Golden Designs all-weather exterior outdoor Hybrid (Traditional Stove or Full Spectrum Infrared) sauna, you can turn that dream of your very own home spa into a reality. Even where space is at a premium, you can still enjoy the good life in the form of a delightfully relaxing and invigorating sauna in the comfort of your own home.
Our Modern Series brings even more relaxation with an all-natural Canadian Red Cedar interior finish, providing an invigorating rich aroma to your sauna session.

Golden Designs outdoor Hybrid (Traditional Stove or Full Spectrum Infrared) saunas provide a healthier way to live. Enjoy the wealth of health benefits a traditional or full spectrum infrared sauna brings to your life. Take the first step to a healthier life!!
